event: PCA PLC environmental product declaration revised November 2023 documents historical PLC inventory sample

evidence_summary: EPD states no separate national PLC production statistics and reports an inventory sample of 820,451 metric tons from 15 plants; this is a sample, not national PLC production.
relevance_to_plc: Documents measurement infrastructure and a quantitative historical industry sample.
interpretation_limit: Revision/publication date is not a manufacturing event date; sample cannot be interpreted as annual U.S. PLC output.
